Jack hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Last Monday, Jack and Eva went to the classroom. They took many photos at the science lab. What's more, the band plays at homecoming each fall.
Jack and Eva had great fun there. The classroom is one of the best places in the city. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Study leave starts next Monday.
Jack spent the weekend at the bookstore. Life is full of small surprises. Jack usually has fish for breakfast. For example, basketball is popular in this city.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the classroom by bike. Jack likes rainy days best. Both of them like fish and coffee.
